## Description

Product ID: 487882

*   Features
    
    Cotton twill outer. Padding in the sleeves and collar combined with natural down in the main body for warmth and ease of movement.
    
    Front slide fastener and hidden snap buttons create a sleek look. Snap-button areas are reinforced with herringbone tape.
    
    Three-dimensional pockets can be accessed from both the top and sides. Brushed lining for extra warmth.
    
    Uniqlo U
    
*   Details
    
    \- Boxy stand-collar jacket. Elastic at the back hem creates A rounded silhouette. Roomy sleeves with Elastic cuffs to prevent bunching.
    
    Function details
    
    \- Fit: Oversized
    
    Product ID: 487882
    
    Images may include colours that are not available.
    
*   Material composition and care instructions
    
    Fabric details
    
    Shell: 100% Cotton/ Filling: Body: 85% Down - Recycled Down, 15% Feathers - Recycled Feathers/ Sleeve: 80% Polyester, 20% Polyester - Recycled Fiber/ Collar: Inner Layer: 80% Polyester, 20% Polyester - Recycled Fiber/ Collar: Outer Layer: 100% Polyester/ Pocket: 100% Polyester/ Lining: 100% Polyester/ Pocket Lining: 100% Polyester
    
    Washing instructions
    
    Hand Wash, Do not Dry Clean, Not suitable for tumble-drying.

*   Production
    
    Production Information
    
    Country/Countries of Production: Vietnam
    
    Fabric knitting and weaving: China
    
    Fabric dyeing: China
    
    We are continuously working to improve our verification of the production process in our supply chain both in-house and with third parties to have full understanding of the origins of raw materials, and the locations of the yarn spinning, fabric production, and garment sewing, knitting and assembly processes. This verification allows us to improve the quality of our clothing and also ensure safer manufacturing practices. We will continue to share information so customers can make informed choices about their clothing.
    
    Fabric production information applies to products manufactured after Autumn/Winter 2024.
